title: The Science Fair Equipment Mix-up
story: Six students collected equipment during six consecutive ten-minute visits. The sign-out sheet is missing. Rebuild it from the surviving records. The calibration unit belongs to the student who collected the Spectrometer. Each student visited one room, presented one project, and collected one item.
